newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - mogas, gasoil firm, fuel not.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - mogas, gasoil firm, fuel not.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday.
Naphtha remained depressed with buying interest muted. But forward paper held firm with the market looking better balanced further out.
Gasoline trade was choppy but prices ended generally firmer and the market's bullish undertone ahead of the spring driving season remained intact.
High sulphur fuel oil was off by a couple of dollars with little utility buying and good supply. Gas oil rose by up to $3 a tonne on the back of stronger futures and firmer premiums.
